socket_definition_candidate.assignment_boundary: BP_NatureArmor Paperdoll has no serialized SkeletalMesh override. Its native template is /Script/Dungeons.Default__GearActor.Paperdoll. Native constructor assignment has not been read; matching socket names and original player skeleton data are not claimed as proof of that native assignment.

limitations: Original Mossy skeletal rig has none of the six armor attachment sockets. Armor player rig composition and adaptation to Mossy are separate steps.
Missing serialized transform properties remain null/unknown locally; native class defaults require separate justification, not invented measured values.
StaticMesh component transforms must compose with socket-relative transforms and skeletal bone world transforms before rendering.
No runtime animation, Blueprint bytecode execution, construction/native modifications, or game scene pose verified.
SproutArmor_Unique1 is excluded as Root Rot identity; five ordinary SproutArmor mesh dependencies are positively assigned by NatureArmor.

assembly_transform_status: Serialized component transforms/socket names are recorded in assembly_source. Unserialized values are not measured identity. Native Paperdoll skeletal mesh assignment remains unproven; no assembled actor transform is applied here.
